adamrk opened PR #15069 from adamrk:abk/start-fn-poisoned-store to bytecodealliance:main:

There is an existing bug where the start function on will run when trying to instantiate a component in a poisoned Store. This fixes that by adding a check to may_enter within invoke_wasm_and_catch_traps so that any Wasm execution will be prevented if the store has been poisoned.

Core Wasm modules should be able to still run after trapping (this is required by some wast tests), so we add an additional flag has_components which will be false as long as no components where initialized in the store. In order to prevent checking two bools on every entry to Wasm, we only check the has_components bool when a trap occurs to decide the trap should cause the Store to be poisoned.

Two calls to may_enter are removed because they are now redundant. Another calls is kept even though it's techinically redundant because it leaves a better error message.
